source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1027 removes redundant imports in the extension parent scripts and records host globals in the historical lint configuration. The independently identified Gecko snapshot's _createExtGlobal supplies AppConstants, XPCOMUtils and ExtensionCommon, plus a lazy ExtensionUtils. Current Comm still explicitly imports XPCOMUtils in ext-mail, so the cleanup is not a rule to remove every repeated import. Check the actual host scope for the code being edited; standalone ES modules need their own import contract. The Gecko snapshot was not built as a matched Comm pair.
title: Verify extension host-provided globals before removing imports
